declarations.HEAD:

    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ

background_index_injective
sum_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem sum_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin B.card, f ((e j).val)) = ∑ i ∈ B, f i

declarations.name: erased_row_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem erased_row_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (H : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin B.card) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, H ((e j).val) ((e k).val)) =
      ∑ i ∈ B.erase ((e j).val), H ((e j).val) i

declarations.name: unorderedPairSum_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem unorderedPairSum_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (H : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hsym : ∀ i j : Fin n, H i j = H j i) :
    Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum
        (fun j k : Fin B.card => H ((e j).val) ((e k).val)) =
      blockPairSum B H

declarations.name: originalUpper_scaled_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem originalUpper_scaled_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a) :
    Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostScalarMoments.originalUpper
        B.card (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) =
      backgroundScale B * blockPairSum B
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))

declarations.name: residualU_background_original_denominator
declarations.HEAD:
theorem residualU_background_original_denominator {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) (j : Fin B.card) :
    Shao.OQ5.P51.residualU
        B.card (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) j =
      (∑ i ∈ B.erase ((e j).val), r (x ((e j).val)) (x i)) /
        ((n : ℝ) - 2)

declarations.name: adjusted_row_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem adjusted_row_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) (j : Fin B.card) :
    g (backgroundSample B e x j) +
        Shao.OQ5.P51.residualU
          B.card (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) j =
      backgroundRow B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i k : Fin n => r (x i) (x k)) ((e j).val)

declarations.name: mean_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem mean_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Shao.OQ5.P35.mean (fun j : Fin B.card => f ((e j).val)) =
      blockMean B f

declarations.name: center_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem center_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin B.card) :
    Shao.OQ5.P35.center (fun k : Fin B.card => f ((e k).val)) j =
      f ((e j).val) - blockMean B f

declarations.name: centered_energy_background_equiv
declarations.HEAD:
theorem centered_energy_background_equiv {n : ℕ}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin B.card,
      (Shao.OQ5.P35.center (fun k : Fin B.card => f ((e k).val)) j) ^ (2 : ℕ)) =
      blockCenteredEnergy B f

declarations.name: projectionW_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem projectionW_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) :
    Shao.OQ5.P51.projectionW B.card g (backgroundSample B e x) =
      (∑ i ∈ B, g (x i)) / Real.sqrt (B.card : ℝ)

declarations.name: numerator_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem numerator_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) :
    Shao.OQ5.P51.projectionW B.card g (backgroundSample B e x) +
        Shao.OQ5.P51.residualStatisticD
          B.card (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) =
      backgroundNumerator B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))

declarations.name: centeredSq_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem centeredSq_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) :
    Shao.OQ5.P51.centeredSq
        B.card g (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) =
      blockCenteredEnergy B
        (backgroundRow B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
          (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))) /
        ((B.card : ℝ) - 1)

declarations.name: sqrt_centeredSq_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem sqrt_centeredSq_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) :
    Real.sqrt (Shao.OQ5.P51.centeredSq
        B.card g (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x)) =
      backgroundStudentizer B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))

declarations.name: jackknife_root_eq_two_sqrt_centeredSq
declarations.HEAD:
theorem jackknife_root_eq_two_sqrt_centeredSq (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt (Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.jackknifeSq
        (Shao.OQ5.P51.sampledKernel n g r x)) =
      2 * Real.sqrt (Shao.OQ5.P51.centeredSq n g r x)

declarations.name: physicalStatistic_eq_projection_ratio
declarations.HEAD:
theorem physicalStatistic_eq_projection_ratio (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    physicalStatistic n g r x =
      (Shao.OQ5.P51.projectionW n g x +
        Shao.OQ5.P51.residualStatisticD n r x) /
        Real.sqrt (Shao.OQ5.P51.centeredSq n g r x)

declarations.name: jackknife_root_background
declarations.HEAD:
theorem jackknife_root_background {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) :
    Real.sqrt (Shao.OQ6.FiniteRows.jackknifeSq
        (Shao.OQ5.P51.sampledKernel B.card g
          (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x))) =
      2 * backgroundStudentizer B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))

declarations.name: physicalStatistic_background_guarded
physicalStatistic_background_total_ratio
declarations.HEAD:
theorem physicalStatistic_background_total_ratio {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card) :
    physicalStatistic B.card g (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) =
      backgroundNumerator B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j)) /
      backgroundStudentizer B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
        (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j))

declarations.name: physicalStatistic_background_zero
declarations.HEAD:
theorem physicalStatistic_background_zero {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type u}
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (e : Fin B.card ≃ {i : Fin n // i ∈ B})
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hm : 4 ≤ B.card)
    (hs : backgroundStudentizer B (fun i : Fin n => g (x i))
      (fun i j : Fin n => r (x i) (x j)) = 0) :
    physicalStatistic B.card g (scaledResidual B r) (backgroundSample B e x) = 0
